subject: Stakeholder mapping & procurement next steps for Aurora Retail
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Harris <tom.harris@aurora-retail.com>, Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@aurora-retail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stakeholder mapping & procurement next steps for Aurora Retail

Hi Tom & Sofia -

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps: 

What we heard
- Primary use case: customer support summarization + agent assist for omni-channel conversations.
- Latency SLO: sub-200ms for 512-token responses on peak traffic.
- Key constraints: data residency for EU customers, SOC2 evidence required, procurement needs vendor onboarding + security questionnaire.

Ask / next steps
1) Can you share a stakeholder list/org chart for the people who will drive procurement, legal/security review, and the economic buyer? Ideally: name, role, and best email.
2) Can procurement share any standard vendor RFP or onboarding checklist?
3) We'd like to schedule a 30-min session with procurement + legal to walk vendor requirements and timeline. Week of Apr 19 is ideal from our side.

I attached my short discovery notes from today - will update after you share stakeholders.

Thanks,
Rishi
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0143

Appreciate the recap, and great summary. Attached is a first-pass org chart showing the key stakeholders across Product, Ops, Security, and Procurement. High-level notes:
